newsitem.title: USA: FIMALAC UNIT, FITCH SAY IN MERGER TALKS.
newsitem.headline: FIMALAC UNIT, FITCH SAY IN MERGER TALKS.

text.p: Fitch Investors Service LP of New York and FIMALAC SA's IBCA Ltd of London said Sunday they are discussing the possibility of a merger.
IBCA said Fitch is a privately-held company.
The companies did not provide further details.
In a telephone interview, IBCA executive vice president Argie Simon said the two companies began discussing the possibility of a merger about several weeks ago.
She said they are hoping to announce an agreement in near future. The announcement of the merger discussion was made in response to rumors, she said.
"The rating agencies are always in discussions," she said. "We have talked to Fitch off and on for several years, and it escalated to the point of talking seriously about four or five weeks ago."
Simon also said it is too early to say what the terms of a merger would be.
She said, however, the deal would be a merger of equals in which the owners of the two companies would retain ownership in the combined company.
Fitch's majority shareholder is the Van Kampen group of Grand Haven, Michigan.
